'''Valentin Panteleimonovich Smirnov''' ({{langx|ru|Валенти́н Пантелеи́монович Cмирно́в}}, b. 2 October 1937), is a Russian scientist, director of the Nuclear Fusion Institute at [[Kurchatov Institute]], and [[academician]] (since 2003)<ref name="RAS_Smirnov_VP">
{{cite web 
|url =http://www.ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-710.ln-ru.dl-.pr-inf.uk-12 
|title=Смирнов Валентин Пантелеймонович ''(Smirnov Valentin Panteleimonovich)'' 
|date= March 22, 2011  
|publisher= [[Russian Academy of Sciences]]
|access-date=August 7, 2012 
| language=ru}}</ref> of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="ge-prize">
{{cite web |url= http://www.ge-prize.com/en/world_committee_folder.php?itemId=5984 |title= Valentin SMIRNOV |access-date= 2009-01-17 |work= Global Energy International Prize |publisher= Global Energy Foundation }}
</ref>

== Graduation and awards ==

* 1961: Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology<ref name="ge-prize"/>
* 1981: Doctor degree phys.-math science<ref name="ge-prize"/>
* 1981: [[USSR State Prize]]<ref name="ge-prize"/>
* 1997: [[State Prize of the Russian Federation]]<ref name="ge-prize"/>
* 2002: Jesse W. Beams Research Award<ref name="ge-prize"/>
* 2005: Hannes Alfvén Prize of the European Physical Society, together with [[Malcolm Golby Haines]] and [[Thomas W. L. Sanford|Thomas Sanford]], "for their major contributions to the development of the multi-wire array in [[Z-pinch]] pulse-power physics".<ref>
{{cite journal |last= Lister |first= Jo |year= 2006 |title= Plasma Physics Division Conference and Hannes Alfvén Prize |journal= Europhysics News |volume= 37 |issue= 1 |pages= 9 |publisher= European Physical Society  |url= http://tsallis.cat.cbpf.br/Erratum-Page25.pdf |access-date= 2009-01-17 }}
</ref>
